newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower, erasing gains.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower, erasing gains.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Friday, as technical selling by local investors erased earlier price gains, traders said.
Prices were 0.8 to 1.6 yen per kg lower, with the benchmark March 1997 contract down 1.3 yen at 135.9.
The yen's weaker sentiment against the dollar encouraged investors to buy in the morning but technical selling from individual investors emerged, they said.
"We're watching for when local rubber stocks will start falling," a brokerage house trader said.
